summary: Bidirectional real-time audio and reliable ordered client-message transport between an Agora channel and a Muxiva graph.

connections.description: Use one App ID and one Channel. Generate two temporary RTC tokens: browser UID 1001 and Muxiva Bot UID 2001.

fields.name: app_id
fields.label: App ID
fields.help: Paste the App ID from the same Agora project used to generate both tokens.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Channel
fields.help: Keep muxiva-demo for the first run. Enter this exact Channel when generating every token.

fields.name: bot_uid
fields.label: Muxiva Bot UID
fields.help: Keep 2001. One shared C++ RTC session receives microphone audio and publishes assistant audio plus client events.

fields.name: bot_token
fields.label: Muxiva Bot Token
fields.help: Generate an RTC token for this App ID, the exact Channel, and numeric UID 2001.

fields.name: web_uid
fields.label: Browser UID
fields.help: Keep 1001. The Voice Room uses this identity for the browser microphone.

fields.name: web_token
fields.label: Browser Token
fields.help: Generate an RTC token for the same App ID and Channel, with numeric UID 1001.
